name: Sleduyushchaya stantsiya
source:
Have betrayals happened often in your life? Have friends, relatives, or just acquaintances stabbed you in the back?
This story is not about the camp. The protagonist is a second-year student at one of the leading Siberian institutes. He finishes his final exams and buys train tickets to visit his freshman girlfriend. What will their long-awaited meeting bring? What route will the protagonist choose for his train called "Life"?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2705003688]Steam[/url]]
